sampling: Initial and after every explicit Playwright mouse action; two animation frames then await native flush if present. Every mouse.move uses steps=1. Callback-time states are also retained.
comparison: Every declared post-action public state and complete ordered add/update/remove/clear callback trace including callback-time states. No event deduplication, filtering, sorting or batching.
platformBoundary: Raw DOM pointer/mouse/capture events and engine-specific client/runtime events retain order, timestamps, targets and payloads. Platform metadata are not asserted byte-identical across the canvas and SVG backends. Unsupported client events remain a separate gap; not a pass.
